% An amsart document beside the stale list of figures and list of tables
% of an earlier build. amsart's own \@starttoc reads these lists, which
% tex4ht sends through the .4ct in the standard classes:
% test-staleaux-toc-amsart.lof, from a build with babel and xcolor, starts
% with babel's \babel@toc and has an entry with \textcolor, and
% test-staleaux-toc-amsart.lot, from a PDF build without hyperref, has a
% three-argument \contentsline, which tex4ht's four-argument
% \contentsline reads past the end of the file. Neither package is loaded
% here. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{amsart}
\begin{document}
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\end{document}
